name: Place Assarag
hero_subtitle: Taroudant’s main square — cafés, taxis and the everyday heart of the walled town.

overview.title: The square that organises the town
overview.p1: Place Assarag is where Taroudant gathers: café terraces, grand taxis and a steady flow of locals. It is a working square that sets the rhythm of the day.
overview.p2: Use it as orientation for the medina, the walls and the souks. Sit for mint tea, then walk into the lanes.

moods.title: Assarag through the day
moods.subtitle: Café shade in the morning, quieter heat at midday, social energy after sunset.

1.title: Café mornings
1.desc: Best time for tea and people-watching before the day hardens.

2.title: Hot and quieter
2.desc: Locals thin out; shade under café awnings helps.

3.title: Square comes alive
3.desc: Evenings bring back conversation and soft light on the square.

food.title: Eat on and near Assarag
food.p1: Café terraces on the square serve tea, coffee and simple snacks. Fuller meals sit a short walk into the medina.
food.p2: Assarag is more about pausing than fine dining.
food.li4: Cash is handy for small café stops.
food.li5: Dinner is easier a few streets away.

1.title: Orientation
1.desc: Most maps of Taroudant start from Assarag — note taxi ranks and main exits to the walls.

2.title: Heat
2.desc: Midday on the open square is intense; plan shaded stops.

3.title: Safety
3.desc: Normal awareness; the square is central and busy in daylight.

q1.question: Is Place Assarag worth a long stop?
q1.answer: Thirty to sixty minutes is enough; use it as a base for the walls and souks.

q2.question: Are there ATMs nearby?
q2.answer: Often in the centre near the square — confirm with your hotel.

q3.question: Best time for photos?
q3.answer: Morning or late afternoon when the light softens.

q4.question: Taxis from Assarag?
q4.answer: Yes — grand taxis and local taxis commonly rank here.

q5.question: Combine with the walls?
q5.answer: Yes — the ramparts are a short walk from the centre.
